title: Comfort Club Price Lock Retention After a Lapse
content:
How much of the locked rate on file a reinstated Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements agreement keeps depends on how quickly it was reinstated and how long the member has been with the club.

The days since lapse are counted from the lapsed term's last day (the day before the current term start) to the date of handling.

## Retention rule
1. **Reinstated no more than 15 days** (the keep days) after the lapsed term's last day: the agreement keeps the locked rate on file as its retained rate.
2. **Reinstated more than 15 days after, and in at least its 6th consecutive term counting the reinstated term** (the halfway term count): the retained rate is the locked rate on file plus half of the difference up to the tier's current first-system annual rate, rounded to the cent half up.
3. **Any other agreement:** no part of the locked rate on file is retained under this rule.

## Worked figures (hypothetical Comfort Club Gold agreement, current first-system annual rate 249.00)

| Locked rate on file | Days since lapse | Consecutive term count (reinstated term included) | Retained rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 229.00 | 12 | any | 229.00 |
| 229.00 | 15 | any | 229.00 |
| 229.00 | 20 | 7 | 229.00 plus half of 20.00, giving 239.00 |
| 230.15 | 20 | 6 | 230.15 plus half of 18.85 is 239.575, rounded half up to 239.58 |
| 229.00 | 20 | 4 | nothing retained under this rule |

## Boundary points
- Day 15 is within the keep days; day 16 is not.
- The 6th term counts: the reinstated term is included in the count.
